facts.fact: RMS Titanic sank after striking an iceberg, resulting in approximately 1,500 deaths.
C Deck had First-Class cabins and was the highest level reached by watertight bulkheads, but water flooded lower decks.
Water temperatures of −2 °C (28 °F) during the Titanic sinking caused hypothermia, with most victims dying in 15–30 minutes.
RMS Titanic sank by foundering, taking in so much water that buoyancy was lost, causing it to break apart.
Titanic had 20 lifeboats, but only 1,178 passengers could be accommodated, far below the total capacity.

sentences.text: What would it feel like to be on the Titanic as it sank?
